description: Provenance of the bundled OpenStreetMap facility records used by the coverage examples.

osm_facilities_southwark.json.source: OpenStreetMap, queried through the Overpass API (https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter) for amenity=charging_station and amenity=toilets within the bounding box of the bundled Southwark boundary
osm_facilities_southwark.json.format: JSON list of GeoPilot Entity records; OSM tags kept unchanged in properties.raw_tags, OSM type/id in properties, provenance per record
caveats: 84 of 163 representative points lie inside the Southwark polygon; the rest lie inside its bounding box.
18 records (OSM ways) use the centre of their bounding box as the coordinate, not an entrance.
No addr:* tags were returned; tags are as mapped by contributors and are not verified against current conditions.
